description_en: Query the list of Layer 4 applications for a site
description_zh: 查询站点对应的四层应用列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-transport-layer-applications --site-id 123456000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 500 --match-type fuzzy --record-name www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransportLayerApplications

parameters.help_en: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html API
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The query type for the host record of Layer 4 applications. The following four types are supported, and the default is exact match.

fuzzy: Fuzzy match.
exact: Exact match.
prefix: Prefix match.
suffix: Suffix match
parameters.help_zh:
针对四层应用主机记录的查询类型，支持以下4种类型，默认为精确查询。

fuzzy：模糊查询。
exact：精确查询。
prefix：前缀匹配查询。
suffix：后缀匹配查询
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The host record of the Layer 4 application
parameters.name: record_name
